incoming.name: Ozone depletion
incoming.section: Current events and future prospects of ozone depletion
incoming.excerpt: The decrease in ozone-depleting chemicals has also been significantly affected by a decrease in bromine-containing chemicals.

incoming.name: Dead Sea
incoming.excerpt: …the Sea was a natural deposit of potash and bromine.

outgoing.name: Agriculture
outgoing.excerpt: Elemental bromine is used to manufacture a wide variety of bromine compounds used in industry and agriculture.

outgoing.name: Citrus
outgoing.excerpt: Bromine is used to make brominated vegetable oil, which is used as an emulsifier in many citrus-flavored soft drinks.

outgoing.name: Crust (geology)
outgoing.excerpt: Bromine occurs in nature as bromide salts in very diffuse amounts in crustal rock.

outgoing.name: Industry
outgoing.excerpt: Elemental bromine is used to manufacture a wide variety of bromine compounds used in industry and agriculture.

outgoing.name: Israel
outgoing.excerpt: Approximately 500 million kilograms ($350 million USD) of bromine are produced per year (2001) worldwide with the United States and Israel being the primary producers.

outgoing.name: Water purification
outgoing.excerpt: Bromine is also used in the manufacture of fumigants, brominated flame-retardants, water purification compounds, dyes, medicines, sanitizers, inorganic bromides for photography, etc.
